name: Renamer
summary: Bulk-renames Cove library items from configurable metadata templates, updating the file on disk and its Cove database record together, with preview and undo.

versions.changelog: Undo is now bounded: it keeps only the most recent rename, records less per file, and refuses to record a rename of more than 5,000 files — the confirmation and the dry-run footer say so before it runs. Any undo pending from before this upgrade is cleared once, on first load; after that undo persists across restarts as before.
Settings render as a full page using Cove's page-layout settings tab — the extension owns the whole tab canvas instead of the host's card chrome. Requires Cove 1.0.0.
First published release: template-based bulk renaming of videos and images with preview, rename, and undo over the extension API.
